names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Константин (Бажанов), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Константина … пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Анатолия, Александра, Евгения, Константина, Николая пресвитеров, и с ними мчч. Петра, Евсевия, Михаила, Дорофея, Лаврентия, Григория и мцц. Александры и Татианы (1937).»

attestations.note: Fourth of the thirteen one line enumerates, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS for him. `related` is left empty for the whole company, as the corpus leaves it for the thirty-four of Valaam; the line is quoted whole here instead. The line says «пресвитеров» and his name page «протоиерей», archpriest. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Бажанов» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under any of the thirteen names.
